rule: Do not weaken or rewrite scientific semantics. Only change presentation hierarchy (primary / expanded / methodology / about).

terms.term: INDEPENDENT_BINARY (independent binary win probability, never shares)
terms.rationale: Load-bearing user-correctness concept; keep as single-line note wherever a model probability is shown, details elsewhere
Needed for family provenance; one compact SIM label suffices by default (DETAILS carries full name)

terms.term: FINITE_MC_SAMPLING_CONTEXT_ONLY (k successes across n futures; interval = sampling precision only)
terms.rationale: Keep one compact precision line by default (n + interval); k/SE/Wilson bounds move to DETAILS
U3 honesty preserved on expert page + DETAILS drawer; not a default-view concept
Keep short form ('simulated differences, never what the team should have done') at strategy/counterfactual entry points; full semantics stay expert
Entry point needs only alternative labels + delta; pairing design moves to results header/expert

terms.term: STAY OUT / PIT NOW / PIT NEXT LAP
terms.rationale: User-facing action vocabulary, not jargon; keep
Compact disagreement lingua franca for pit-wall row; definition one tap away

terms.term: anchor driver / anchor state time / exact anchor (no interpolation)
terms.rationale: Mechanism detail; default UI says 'Lap N / race time' and DETAILS explains anchoring
Contract identifiers belong in provenance, not headers

terms.term: Engine v3.6c / v3.7c / runtime v3.7f / MC2-E labels
terms.rationale: Version strings are provenance; keep single 'Simulation' label by default
Reproducibility control, not a primary decision input; advanced-collapsed

terms.term: SUPPORTED STATE / eligible targets / precomputed catalogue
terms.rationale: Availability mechanics; entry point needs only enabled/disabled + reason line

terms.term: Spearman rank correlation / top-3 Jaccard / average-tie ranks
terms.rationale: Telemetry detail; default keeps leader-agreement wording only

terms.term: AT T / stale age / NO DATA row semantics
terms.rationale: Factual-honesty cue; keep compact chip form, legend in DETAILS

terms.term: RED FLAG / SAFETY CAR / VIRTUAL SC / YELLOW / GREEN + RAIN
